overview: White offers a second pawn after 2.e4 dxe4, trying to open the d-file and develop quickly with Bxd3 or Qxd3 ideas. Black can take again on d3 or decline with ...e5, ...Nf6 or ...Nc6, usually with a comfortable extra pawn. It is a rare gambit that relies on surprise and activity rather than a proven edge.

white_ideas.idea: Open lines with d3, recapture with Bxd3 or Qxd3 and develop rapidly.
Seek a lead in development and pressure on the d-file and kingside.

black_ideas.idea: Keep the extra pawn, develop ...Nf6 and ...Nc6, and trade queens if White overreaches.
Decline with ...e5 and play for a solid position.

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with an extra Black pawn on e4 or d3 and White's pieces developed quickly.

character.notes: A gambit with an open centre and loose pieces; Black has easy ways to hold the material.

gambit.notes: Black can keep the extra pawn with careful play.

soundness.notes: Generally considered unsound; scores through surprise.

level.notes: Needs knowledge of gambit lines; not a first repertoire choice.

character.reason: Pawn gambit with open lines and risks.

gambit.reason: White gives a pawn that Black can keep.

plans.reason: White trades a pawn for development.
